This is because dogs have different nutritional needs than humans, and they require a consistent and reliable food supply to stay healthy. By providing a full bowl of food, you're ensuring that your dog is getting the nutrients he needs to thrive. Additionally, dogs often have a strong sense of routine and may become anxious or stressed if their meals are inconsistent or unpredictable. Placing a full bowl of food at regular intervals can help provide a sense of stability and comfort for your dog. Of course, it's also important to monitor your dog's food intake and adjust the amount as needed to prevent overeating or under-eating, but in general, providing a full bowl of food at mealtime is a responsible and caring thing to do.
